summary: schema.ts 2026-07-28 defines a stateless, per-request-negotiated MCP. LATEST_PROTOCOL_VERSION="2026-07-28", JSONRPC_VERSION="2.0". There is NO initialize/initialized/ping/logging/setLevel/resources/subscribe/unsubscribe/roots list_changed/elicitation complete/tasks methods. Every client request carries a REQUIRED `params._meta` (RequestMetaObject) with required keys `io.modelcontextprotocol/protocolVersion` and `io.modelcontextprotocol/clientCapabilities`, optional `progressToken`, `io.modelcontextprotocol/clientInfo`, deprecated `io.modelcontextprotocol/logLevel`. Every server Result MUST carry `resultType` ("complete" | "input_required" | open string); clients treat absence (older servers) as "complete". Results MAY carry `_meta["io.modelcontextprotocol/serverInfo"]`. Discovery is `server/discover` (server MUST implement, client MAY call) returning supportedVersions, capabilities, instructions?, ttlMs, cacheScope. List results and resources/read are CacheableResult (required `ttlMs` >=0 and `cacheScope` "public"|"private"). Server-initiated interactions (sampling/createMessage, roots/list, elicitation/create — all but elicitation deprecated by SEP-2577) are no longer JSON-RPC requests: they are embedded as `InputRequests` inside an `InputRequiredResult` (resultType "input_required", at least one of inputRequests/requestState) returned for tools/call, prompts/get, resources/read; the client retries the original request with `inputResponses` + opaque `requestState`. Notifications outside a request flow only over a long-lived `subscriptions/listen` request (opt-in SubscriptionFilter; server MUST first send `notifications/subscriptions/acknowledged`; every stream notification carries `_meta["io.modelcontextprotocol/subscriptionId"]` = listen request id; graceful close = SubscriptionsListenResult; on stdio server sends notifications/cancelled referencing the listen id to terminate). ClientNotification = only notifications/cancelled; ClientResult = EmptyResult. New MCP error codes: -32020 HEADER_MISMATCH, -32021 MISSING_REQUIRED_CLIENT_CAPABILITY (data.requiredCapabilities), -32022 UNSUPPORTED_PROTOCOL_VERSION (data.supported[], data.requested); all HTTP 400. -32002 and -32042 reserved, never reused; -32000..-32019 implementation-defined; -32020..-32099 spec-reserved. Tool.inputSchema is any JSON Schema 2020-12 with root type "object" (optional `x-mcp-header` property annotation); outputSchema any schema; structuredContent any JSON value. Content blocks: text, image, audio, resource_link, resource (+ tool_use/tool_result for sampling only). LoggingLevel = 8 syslog levels (deprecated).

requirements.text: Implement the server/discover method.
Call server/discover; not required — version negotiation can happen inline via per-request _meta.
Include `_meta["io.modelcontextprotocol/protocolVersion"]` (string) on every request (RequestParams._meta is required and this key is non-optional).
Include `_meta["io.modelcontextprotocol/clientCapabilities"]` (ClientCapabilities, may be {}) on every request; capabilities are declared per-request, not at initialization.
Infer client capabilities from prior requests.
On HTTP, reject with 400 Bad Request when `_meta["io.modelcontextprotocol/protocolVersion"]` does not match the `MCP-Protocol-Version` header (HeaderMismatchError -32020).
Return UnsupportedProtocolVersionError (-32022, data.supported: string[], data.requested: string; HTTP 400) when the requested protocol version is unsupported.
Return MissingRequiredClientCapabilityError (-32021, data.requiredCapabilities: ClientCapabilities; HTTP 400) when processing requires a client capability not declared in clientCapabilities.
Return METHOD_NOT_FOUND (-32601) for unknown methods and for methods gated behind an unadvertised server capability (e.g. prompts/list without prompts capability).
Include `_meta["io.modelcontextprotocol/clientInfo"]` (Implementation) on every request unless configured not to.
Use clientInfo to change behavior or for security decisions.
Include `_meta["io.modelcontextprotocol/serverInfo"]` (Implementation) on every response unless configured not to.
Use serverInfo to change behavior or for security decisions.
Include `resultType` in every Result.
Treat an absent `resultType` (server on earlier protocol version) as "complete".
Send notifications/message for a request whose _meta lacks `io.modelcontextprotocol/logLevel`.
Make assumptions about values at MCP-reserved `_meta` keys.

_meta key prefix, if present, is dot-separated labels followed by '/'; labels start with a letter, end with letter or digit, interior letters/digits/hyphens; name part (unless empty) starts and ends with [a-z0-9A-Z], interior alphanumeric/-/_/. Prefixes whose second label is `modelcontextprotocol` or `mcp` are reserved.
Use reverse-DNS notation for _meta key prefixes (com.example/ not example.com/).
ClientCapabilities.extensions and ServerCapabilities.extensions keys follow _meta key naming rules with a mandatory prefix.
InputRequiredResult contains at least one of `inputRequests` or `requestState`.
Treat `requestState` as an opaque blob and never interpret it; pass it back on retry.
For each key in InputRequiredResult.inputRequests, place the same key in the retry request's `inputResponses` with the corresponding result.
notifications/cancelled.requestId corresponds to a request the client previously issued.
Use notifications/cancelled for anything other than terminating a subscriptions/listen stream (stdio); it references the listen request id.
Cease processing of a cancelled request; the request SHOULD still be in-flight but MAY have finished due to latency.
Log or present the cancellation `reason` to the user.
Send notification types on a subscriptions/listen stream that the client did not explicitly opt into via SubscriptionFilter.
Include `_meta["io.modelcontextprotocol/subscriptionId"]` (= JSON-RPC id of the listen request) on every notification delivered via a subscriptions/listen stream and on the SubscriptionsListenResult.

Send notifications/subscriptions/acknowledged as the first message carrying the subscription's ID, and MUST NOT send any notification on that subscription before acknowledging it (ordering per subscription ID on stdio; other subscriptions MAY interleave).
Only send notifications/resources/updated for URIs the client listed in resourceSubscriptions; list_changed notifications only when the corresponding filter flag is true.
Provide `ttlMs` (>=0) and `cacheScope` on every CacheableResult (DiscoverResult, ListResourcesResult, ListResourceTemplatesResult, ReadResourceResult, ListPromptsResult, ListToolsResult).
Consider a cacheable result fresh for ttlMs milliseconds; if ttlMs is 0 consider it immediately stale (MAY re-fetch every time).
Share a `cacheScope: "private"` cached response across authorization contexts (different access token = different cache).
Cache a `cacheScope: "public"` response in any client or intermediary and serve across authorization contexts.
Tool.inputSchema root has type "object"; defaults to JSON Schema 2020-12 when $schema absent; any 2020-12 keyword allowed (oneOf/anyOf/allOf/not/if/then/else/$ref/$defs/$anchor).
Annotate inputSchema property schemas with `x-mcp-header` to mirror an argument into an HTTP header on Streamable HTTP (rules in transport spec).
Report tool-originated errors inside CallToolResult with isError:true, not as protocol errors; errors finding the tool / unsupported tools -> protocol error.
When rendering icons, support image/png and image/jpeg (and image/jpg); SHOULD support image/svg+xml and image/webp.
Ensure icon URLs come from the same domain as the client/server or a trusted domain, and take precautions with SVGs (executable JS).
completion.values must not exceed 100 items.
Return an error if sampling `tools` or `toolChoice` is provided but ClientCapabilities.sampling.tools was not declared.
Omit `includeContext` or use "none"; only use deprecated thisServer/allServers if client declares sampling.context.
Evaluate sampling ModelPreferences.hints in order (first match wins); SHOULD prioritize hints over numeric priorities but MAY use priorities for ambiguous matches.
Treat ModelHint.name as a substring of a model name; MAY map to another provider's equivalent model.
Ignore modelPreferences, modify/omit systemPrompt, ignore includeContext, sample fewer tokens than maxTokens.
ToolResultContent.toolUseId matches the id of a previous ToolUseContent.
Preserve _meta on ToolUseContent and ToolResultContent when including them in subsequent sampling requests (caching optimizations).
ToolResultContent.structuredContent conforms to Tool.outputSchema if one is defined.
Root.uri starts with `file://`.
Never make tool-use decisions based on ToolAnnotations from untrusted servers (all annotation properties are hints).
Error.message is a concise single sentence.
Assign cross-implementation semantics to error codes -32000..-32019 (implementation-defined); spec never defines codes there. -32002 and -32042 remain reserved and are never reused.
Elicitation requestedSchema is a restricted flat JSON Schema: type "object", only top-level primitive properties, no nesting.
ElicitResult.content only when action is "accept" and mode was "form"; omitted for url mode.
Inform the user before beginning sampling and before returning the sampled message (human in the loop).
TextResourceContents.text only set if item can be represented as text; BlobResourceContents.blob is base64.

wire_details: LATEST_PROTOCOL_VERSION = "2026-07-28"; JSONRPC_VERSION = "2.0" (L30-32).

JSON-RPC: JSONRPCRequest {jsonrpc:"2.0"; id: RequestId; method; params?}; JSONRPCNotification {jsonrpc; method; params?}; JSONRPCResultResponse {jsonrpc; id; result: Result}; JSONRPCErrorResponse {jsonrpc; id?: RequestId (OPTIONAL); error: Error {code:number; message:string; data?:unknown}} (L268-309). RequestId = string|number; ProgressToken = string|number; Cursor = string.
Standard error codes: PARSE_ERROR -32700, INVALID_REQUEST -32600, METHOD_NOT_FOUND -32601, INVALID_PARAMS -32602, INTERNAL_ERROR -32603 (L312-316).

MCP error codes: HEADER_MISMATCH -32020, MISSING_REQUIRED_CLIENT_CAPABILITY -32021 (error.data.requiredCapabilities: ClientCapabilities), UNSUPPORTED_PROTOCOL_VERSION -32022 (error.data.supported: string[], error.data.requested: string). All three: HTTP status MUST be 400 Bad Request (L434-526). Range -32000..-32019 implementation-defined; -32020..-32099 spec-reserved, allocated sequentially; -32002 (resource not found, <=2025-11-25, now -32602) and -32042 (URL elicitation required, 2025-11-25 only) reserved/never reused.

HTTP header referenced by schema: `MCP-Protocol-Version` — MUST equal _meta["io.modelcontextprotocol/protocolVersion"] of the body, else 400 (L71-73). No other header names appear in schema.ts (session id headers etc. are NOT in this file).

Request _meta keys (RequestMetaObject, L63-111): progressToken?: string|number; "io.modelcontextprotocol/protocolVersion": string (REQUIRED); "io.modelcontextprotocol/clientInfo"?: Implementation; "io.modelcontextprotocol/clientCapabilities": ClientCapabilities (REQUIRED); "io.modelcontextprotocol/logLevel"?: LoggingLevel (deprecated). RequestParams { _meta: RequestMetaObject } — _meta itself is REQUIRED on client requests.

Result _meta keys (ResultMetaObject, L143-158): "io.modelcontextprotocol/serverInfo"?: Implementation. Result { _meta?; resultType: ResultType (REQUIRED); [key]: unknown }. ResultType = "complete" | "input_required" | string. EmptyResult = Result.

Notification _meta keys (NotificationMetaObject, L120-134): "io.modelcontextprotocol/subscriptionId"?: RequestId. NotificationParams { _meta?: NotificationMetaObject }. SubscriptionsListenResultMetaObject: "io.modelcontextprotocol/subscriptionId": RequestId (REQUIRED).

Extension identifier examples given as keys of capabilities.extensions: "io.modelcontextprotocol/oauth-client-credentials" (client, L776), "io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks" (server, L873); "io.modelcontextprotocol/ui" MIME-type example referenced by example file name only (L782-783). Values are per-extension JSONObject; {} = supported with no settings.

Method name constants (client->server): server/discover, resources/list, resources/templates/list, resources/read, prompts/list, prompts/get, tools/list, tools/call, completion/complete, subscriptions/listen. Notifications: notifications/cancelled (c->s; s->c on stdio for listen teardown), notifications/progress, notifications/message, notifications/resources/updated, notifications/resources/list_changed, notifications/prompts/list_changed, notifications/tools/list_changed, notifications/subscriptions/acknowledged (all s->c). Embedded InputRequest methods (server->client via InputRequiredResult): sampling/createMessage, roots/list, elicitation/create.

Unions (L3151-3197): ClientRequest = DiscoverRequest | CompleteRequest | GetPromptRequest | ListPromptsRequest | ListResourcesRequest | ListResourceTemplatesRequest | ReadResourceRequest | SubscriptionsListenRequest | CallToolRequest | ListToolsRequest. ClientNotification = CancelledNotification. ClientResult = EmptyResult. ServerNotification = CancelledNotification | ProgressNotification | LoggingMessageNotification | ResourceUpdatedNotification | ResourceListChangedNotification | ToolListChangedNotification | PromptListChangedNotification | SubscriptionsAcknowledgedNotification. ServerResult = EmptyResult | DiscoverResult | CompleteResult | GetPromptResult | ListPromptsResult | ListResourceTemplatesResult | ListResourcesResult | ReadResourceResult | SubscriptionsListenResult | CallToolResult | ListToolsResult | InputRequiredResult. There is NO ServerRequest union. InputRequest = CreateMessageRequest | ListRootsRequest | ElicitRequest; InputResponse = CreateMessageResult | ListRootsResult | ElicitResult; InputRequests/InputResponses = {[serverAssignedKey: string]: ...}.

ClientCapabilities (L716-786): experimental?: {[k]: JSONObject}; roots?: {} (deprecated, no sub-fields); sampling?: { context?: JSONObject; tools?: JSONObject } (deprecated); elicitation?: { form?: JSONObject; url?: JSONObject }; extensions?: {[k]: JSONObject}.

ServerCapabilities (L793-883): experimental?: {[k]: JSONObject}; logging?: JSONObject (deprecated); completions?: JSONObject; prompts?: { listChanged?: boolean }; resources?: { subscribe?: boolean; listChanged?: boolean }; tools?: { listChanged?: boolean }; extensions?: {[k]: JSONObject}. No `tasks` capability.

Implementation (L976-997) extends BaseMetadata, Icons: name: string (req); title?: string; version: string (req); description?: string; websiteUrl?: string (uri); icons?: Icon[]. Icon (L890-927): src: string (req; http(s) or data: URI); mimeType?: string; sizes?: string[] ("WxH" or "any"); theme?: "light"|"dark". BaseMetadata: name (req), title?.

Content block discriminators (`type`): "text" (TextContent {text; annotations?; _meta?}), "image" (ImageContent {data: base64; mimeType: string (req); annotations?; _meta?}), "audio" (AudioContent {data; mimeType (req); annotations?; _meta?}), "resource_link" (ResourceLink extends Resource: uri, name, title?, description?, mimeType?, annotations?, size?, icons?, _meta?), "resource" (EmbeddedResource {resource: TextResourceContents|BlobResourceContents; annotations?; _meta?}). ContentBlock = these five (L2305-2306). Sampling-only: "tool_use" (ToolUseContent {id; name; input: object; _meta?}), "tool_result" (ToolResultContent {toolUseId; content: ContentBlock[]; structuredContent?: unknown; isError?; _meta?}). SamplingMessageContentBlock = Text|Image|Audio|ToolUse|ToolResult (L2258-2263).
Annotations (L2270-2300): audience?: Role[]; priority?: number (0..1); lastModified?: string (ISO 8601, e.g. "2025-01-12T15:00:58Z"). Role = "user" | "assistant" (L1694).
LoggingLevel (L2075-2083, deprecated): "debug","info","notice","warning","error","critical","alert","emergency" (RFC 5424 order).

ElicitResult.action: "accept" | "decline" | "cancel". Elicit modes: "form" (optional/default) | "url". StringSchema.format: "email"|"uri"|"date"|"date-time". Completion refs: "ref/prompt", "ref/resource".

CreateMessageResult.stopReason standard values: "endTurn","stopSequence","maxTokens","toolUse" (open string). ToolChoice.mode: "auto"|"required"|"none". includeContext: "none"|"thisServer"|"allServers".
CacheableResult.cacheScope: "public" | "private"; ttlMs: number >= 0 (milliseconds; HTTP max-age analogue).
Icon MIME types: image/png, image/jpeg, image/jpg (MUST); image/svg+xml, image/webp (SHOULD). Icon mimeType examples: "image/png", "image/jpeg", "image/svg+xml".

JSON Schema: Tool.inputSchema/outputSchema default to JSON Schema 2020-12 when no $schema; `x-mcp-header` is a recognized property-level annotation key. 2026-07-28_schema.json itself declares $schema https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema.

Base64 fields (@format byte): ImageContent.data, AudioContent.data, BlobResourceContents.blob. URI fields (@format uri): Resource.uri, ResourceContents.uri, Icon.src, Implementation.websiteUrl, Root.uri, ElicitRequestURLParams.url, ResourceRequestParams.uri, ResourceUpdatedNotificationParams.uri. uri-template: ResourceTemplate.uriTemplate, ResourceTemplateReference.uri.
sdk_implications: No handshake layer: drop initialize/initialized/ping. Client SDK must stamp every outgoing request's params._meta with protocolVersion (required), clientCapabilities (required, may be {}), and by default clientInfo; optionally progressToken and logLevel. Server SDK must validate presence of _meta.protocolVersion and _meta.clientCapabilities on every request and evaluate capability gates per request, never caching from earlier requests.

Server SDK must implement server/discover unconditionally, returning supportedVersions (must include "2026-07-28"), capabilities, optional instructions, ttlMs and cacheScope. Client SDK should offer an optional Discover() that caches per ttlMs/cacheScope and can pick a version from supportedVersions; if -32022 is returned, client should retry with a version from error.data.supported.

Server SDK must emit `resultType` on every result ("complete" for normal, "input_required" for InputRequiredResult) and stamp _meta.serverInfo by default. Client SDK must default missing resultType to "complete" and branch on resultType before parsing the result body (CallToolResult|InputRequiredResult etc.).

Implement the multi-round-trip loop in the client: on resultType "input_required", dispatch each inputRequests[key] to a registered handler (elicitation form/url, sampling, roots) based on `method`, collect InputResponses under the same keys, and re-issue the ORIGINAL request with inputResponses + requestState (opaque). Server SDK needs a helper to build InputRequiredResult (validating at least one of inputRequests/requestState), to key requests, and to read inputResponses/requestState from the retried tools/call, prompts/get, resources/read params. Sampling/roots/elicitation handlers are no longer JSON-RPC request handlers with ids.

Error model: expose constants -32700/-32600/-32601/-32602/-32603/-32020/-32021/-32022; typed error classes with data shapes (supported/requested; requiredCapabilities). HTTP transport must map -32020/-32021/-32022 to status 400 and must compare the MCP-Protocol-Version header with body _meta. Keep -32000..-32019 free for SDK-internal use; never emit -32002/-32042. Use -32602 for resource-not-found, unknown tool/prompt, bad cursor, bad log level, undeclared elicitation mode. JSONRPCErrorResponse.id must be optional (nullable) in the model.

Subscriptions: client SDK needs a long-lived Listen(filter) primitive whose request id is the stream key; it must wait for notifications/subscriptions/acknowledged (reading the honored SubscriptionFilter), route notifications by _meta["io.modelcontextprotocol/subscriptionId"], treat a SubscriptionsListenResult as graceful close, and (on stdio) accept a server-sent notifications/cancelled referencing the listen id. Server SDK must track listen streams per request id, send acknowledged first (with subscriptionId), only send opted-in notification types, stamp subscriptionId on every stream notification, and close via SubscriptionsListenResult or (stdio) notifications/cancelled. No resources/subscribe|unsubscribe handlers; no logging/setLevel handler; log level comes from per-request _meta.

Cacheable results: server-side list/read helpers must require ttlMs and cacheScope (e.g., parameters or sensible defaults such as ttlMs 0 / "private"). Client-side optional cache keyed by method+params and authorization context, honoring public/private semantics.

Type model (PowerShell classes/hashtables + JSON validation) for: JSONRPC message shapes, RequestMetaObject/ResultMetaObject/NotificationMetaObject, ClientCapabilities/ServerCapabilities (incl. experimental/extensions maps), Implementation/Icon/Annotations, Resource/ResourceTemplate/Text|BlobResourceContents, Prompt/PromptArgument/PromptMessage, Tool/ToolAnnotations (inputSchema arbitrary 2020-12 with root type object; outputSchema arbitrary; structuredContent any JSON value), CallToolResult, CompleteRequest/Result (cap 100 values), SubscriptionFilter, InputRequests/InputResponses/InputRequiredResult, Elicit form/url params + PrimitiveSchemaDefinition variants (5 enum shapes incl. legacy enumNames), ElicitResult, Sampling types (marked deprecated), Root, LoggingLevel enum, Role enum, all five ContentBlock types plus tool_use/tool_result.

_meta key validation utility implementing the prefix/name grammar and reserved-prefix check (second label modelcontextprotocol or mcp); used for _meta keys and for capabilities.extensions keys (prefix mandatory).

Tool registration API should accept arbitrary JSON Schema 2020-12 input schemas (not just properties/required), support outputSchema, annotations, icons, _meta, and optionally x-mcp-header annotations; must validate structuredContent against outputSchema when present; tool exceptions map to isError:true results, not protocol errors.

Progress: client sets _meta.progressToken; server helper sends notifications/progress (progressToken, progress, total?, message?) without subscriptionId; client SDK routes by progressToken. Only the server sends progress in this version (client-side sampling progress no longer exists).
Cancellation: client can send notifications/cancelled for in-flight ids; server SDK should wire it to a cancellation token per request id and tolerate late arrival.

Deprecation surfacing: mark roots, sampling, logging, logLevel _meta, notifications/message as deprecated (SEP-2577) in help/docs but still implement for the >=12-month window; sampling client handler must reject tools/toolChoice when sampling.tools not declared and implement hint ordering.
Icon rendering (if the client host renders): support png/jpeg minimum; svg/webp recommended; enforce same-domain/trusted-domain policy for icon src.

Dual-era support: transport/protocol layer needs a version switch keyed by the negotiated version (2025-11-25/2025-06-18 use initialize handshake, direct JSON-RPC server->client requests with ids, resources/subscribe, logging/setLevel, GET SSE stream, no resultType/ttlMs/cacheScope) versus 2026-07-28 semantics above.
legacy_delta: Removed methods (present in 2025-11-25 and 2025-06-18, absent in 2026-07-28): initialize, notifications/initialized, ping, logging/setLevel, resources/subscribe, resources/unsubscribe, notifications/roots/list_changed. Removed 2025-11-25-only: notifications/elicitation/complete, tasks/get, tasks/result, tasks/list, tasks/cancel, notifications/tasks/status (tasks now only appear as an extension identifier example "io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks").

Added methods: server/discover (replaces initialize/InitializeResult: supportedVersions[] instead of single protocolVersion; serverInfo moved to _meta), subscriptions/listen, notifications/subscriptions/acknowledged.

Handshake state removed: 2025-x InitializeRequestParams {protocolVersion, capabilities, clientInfo} become per-request _meta keys io.modelcontextprotocol/protocolVersion, /clientCapabilities, /clientInfo. Older schemas defined no io.modelcontextprotocol/* keys at all; 2026-07-28 defines protocolVersion, clientInfo, clientCapabilities, logLevel, serverInfo, subscriptionId.
Result gained required `resultType` (absent in 2025-x; clients must default to "complete"). New CacheableResult (ttlMs, cacheScope) on discover/list/read results — not in 2025-x.

Server->client requests changed shape: 2025-x ServerRequest = ping | sampling/createMessage | roots/list | elicitation/create | tasks/* as real JSON-RPC requests with ids and ClientResult union of their results. 2026-07-28 has no ServerRequest; these become InputRequest objects (no id/jsonrpc) inside InputRequiredResult.inputRequests, answered via inputResponses on a retried request; ClientResult = EmptyResult only. InputRequiredResult/InputResponseRequestParams/requestState are new.

ClientNotification shrank: 2025-11-25 = cancelled | progress | initialized | roots/list_changed | tasks/status; 2026-07-28 = cancelled only. ProgressNotification is now server->client only. CancelledNotification gained the stdio server-side use for listen-stream teardown.

ClientCapabilities: roots changed from { listChanged?: boolean } to {} and deprecated; sampling deprecated (same sub-fields context/tools); tasks capability removed; elicitation unchanged; extensions present in both (2025-11-25 added it). ServerCapabilities: tasks removed; logging deprecated; others unchanged.
ElicitRequestURLParams lost `elicitationId` (2025-11-25 had elicitationId + URL_ELICITATION_REQUIRED -32042 error). -32042 now reserved/unused. 2025-06-18 had no url mode at all.

Error codes: 2025-x defined only JSON-RPC standard codes plus (2025-11-25) URL_ELICITATION_REQUIRED -32042 and used -32002 for resource not found. 2026-07-28 adds -32020/-32021/-32022, moves resource-not-found to -32602, defines the -32000..-32019 / -32020..-32099 partition.

Tool: 2025-11-25 inputSchema/outputSchema were { $schema?, type:"object", properties?, required? } and Tool had `execution?: ToolExecution` (taskSupport). 2026-07-28: inputSchema is open 2020-12 with root type object, outputSchema is fully open (no type constraint), no execution field, x-mcp-header annotation introduced. CallToolResult.structuredContent widened from object to any JSON value (unknown).

Logging: logging/setLevel RPC replaced by per-request _meta io.modelcontextprotocol/logLevel; whole logging feature deprecated (SEP-2577). Sampling, roots, logging deprecated in 2026-07-28 with >=12-month retention; includeContext thisServer/allServers deprecated since 2025-11-25 (SEP-2596).

Notification delivery: 2025-x list_changed / resources/updated notifications could be sent anytime (HTTP GET SSE stream); 2026-07-28 only on an opted-in subscriptions/listen stream with subscriptionId _meta and mandatory ack.

2025-06-18 additionally lacked (vs 2025-11-25): icons, elicitation url mode, sampling tools/toolChoice/tool_use/tool_result content, tasks, extensions capability, ClientCapabilities.sampling sub-fields. A dual-era SDK must gate these by negotiated version.

Unchanged across eras: JSONRPC_VERSION "2.0", standard JSON-RPC codes, Cursor/pagination (cursor/nextCursor), ContentBlock five types, Role, LoggingLevel values, Annotations, completion/complete shape (values max 100), prompts/get and prompts/list shapes, Root file:// rule.
open_questions: schema.ts references only the MCP-Protocol-Version header; session-id headers, Accept/Content-Type requirements, SSE framing, POST/GET semantics and the `x-mcp-header` extraction rules live in the Streamable HTTP transport page (not in this file) and must be extracted from pages/ separately.
Exact keep-alive replacement for `ping` (absent from schema) is unspecified in schema.ts; check basic/lifecycle or transport pages for liveness guidance.

Whether a client may send subscriptions/listen before any server/discover and how the server signals unsupported filter flags beyond omitting them from the acknowledged set (no error code is specified).
Whether InputRequests keys have a constrained format (schema says only 'server-assigned identifiers').
Whether the retried request after InputRequiredResult MUST reuse the same JSON-RPC id or the same params (schema only says 'retry the original request').
Format/location of the 'deprecated features registry' referenced by @deprecated notes (SEP-2577) and the exact removal timeline (>=12 months).

Whether `io.modelcontextprotocol/logLevel` applies only to the request it is attached to (schema: 'for this request') — implies servers must scope log emission per in-flight request; interaction with subscriptions/listen streams is unspecified.

DiscoverResult.supportedVersions vs. the version the client puts in _meta on the discover request itself: schema does not say which version to use for the very first request when the client does not know the server's versions (presumably LATEST, with -32022 fallback).
